import html # Predefined template for blog posts. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(heading: str, content: str) -> str: """ Render a user‑submitted blog entry safely for display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The title of the blog post. content : str The main body text of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted HTML for the blog post. Notes ----- - The function escapes all user‑supplied text to prevent XSS attacks. - It uses the global ``BLOG_FORMAT`` template, which must contain ``{title}`` and ``{body}`` placeholders. """ # Sanitize user input to avoid injection attacks safe_title = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Format the sanitized strings into the template formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
